explanations.headline: No. 10's run pulled a defender and opened space

claims.text: North London Red's No. 10 moved 14 metres and pulled the defender marking them away from the pass spot.
This movement nearly tripled the open space where a teammate received the ball without No. 10 touching it.

explanations.headline: H10’s run pulls marker A6 away and creates space for teammate

claims.text: H10 ran 14.2 metres off the ball while marker A6 moved 7.2 metres following H10’s run direction exactly.
A6’s distance to the receiving zone increased by 3.9 metres, creating an extra 181 square metres of space.
A teammate then received the ball in the central penalty area and took a shot 2.2 seconds after the pass, with H10 not touching the ball.

explanations.headline: H10's run increased space for a teammate in central lane

claims.text: At 10.0 seconds, H10 ran 14.2 metres off the ball, dragging defender A6 along a matched direction with cosine 1.0, creating space in the central lane of the penalty area.
Defender A6's distance to the receiving spot increased from 5.4 metres to 9.3 metres, with a marker pull of 3.9 metres.
The free space at the receiving zone expanded from 93 m² to 274 m², a gain of 181 m², making the receiving space 2.9 times larger by the pass time.
The detector confidence for this space creation event was 0.69, with confidence parts 0.49 for marker pull, 1.0 for marker follow, and 0.65 for freed space.

explanations.headline: No. 6's return pass cut out two players

claims.text: North London Red's No. 8 passed to No. 6, who returned the ball cutting out two South Coast Blue players.

explanations.headline: H8 and H6 combined to break lines and create a chance

claims.text: H8 started the move with a pass to H6 at 6.4 seconds.
H6 returned a line-breaking pass to H8 at 7.1 seconds, bypassing opponents A10 and A11.
The attack progressed 24.0 metres through 3 passes and began several seconds before the shot.

explanations.headline: Home team started chance with a one-two sequence bypassing opponents

claims.text: Player H8 initiated the chance with a pass at 6.4 seconds into the clip.
Player H6 played the line-breaking return pass at 7.1 seconds, bypassing 2 opponents, A10 and A11.
The sequence included 3 passes from the origin to the shot, covering a progression of 24.0 metres.
The chance began 5.8 seconds before the shot with a detector confidence of 0.78, including 0.67 confidence for lines and 0.96 for progression.
